scares.description: The gas station attendant appears beside Michelle’s window.
Damon comes up behind Brenda and Natalie and surprises them.
Natalie is surprised by the janitor as she enters her campus hall.
Someone appears behind Damon and puts a rope around his neck while he is urinating in the woods.
A hooded figure appears in front of Natalie.
Sasha runs into Natalie in the library.
The killer grabs Tosh around the mouth.
Natalie opens a door in Professor Wexler’s office and is surprised by a coat resembling the one worn by the killer.
Natalie pulls back a door to reveal Professor Wexler.
Reese puts her hand on Dean Adams shoulder as he goes to open his car door.
A knife appears from underneath the car, and Dean Adams ankle is cut.
Sasha walks up to a window as is surprised by the hooded killer appearing on the other side.
Sasha runs into the killer on some stairs.
Natalie and Paul are surprised by Brenda coming around a corner.
Natalie opens a door and Parker’s dead body falls out.
Natalie opens another door and sees Damon’s dead body hanging.
